versions.changelog: Bilingual documentation update (English + Chinese)! 1) SKILL.md now fully bilingual with complete English/Chinese sections 2) Emergency recovery guides bilingual (~/OPENCLAW_EMERGENCY_RECOVERY.md and ~/.openclaw/backups/README.md) 3) All user-facing text now in both languages for better accessibility 4) Improved Chinese localization for native speakers

Critical update: Added emergency recovery system! 1) New independent restore.sh script (works without OpenClaw running) 2) Emergency recovery guides in home directory and backup directory 3) Updated recovery-guide.md to use independent script 4) Added emergency recovery section to SKILL.md and backup-strategies.md 5) Now users can recover even if OpenClaw is completely broken!
Update: Migrate to new OpenClaw skill format. Simplified SKILL.md frontmatter, removed slug/version from SKILL.md, added metadata field with emoji and requirements.
Initial release: Complete backup management system with automated daily/weekly/monthly backups, pre-modification snapshots, expired cleanup, and comprehensive recovery guide.
